logline: Thrown into the castle's subterranean wet cells as Catherine threatens to burn her mother's herbarium and frame her for witchcraft, Juliana breaks down in isolation before swearing that they will never take Alexander from her.

moments.description: Uniformed guards forcibly drag Juliana down a dark, dripping dungeon stairwell while she struggles in vain.
Juliana begs Catherine in tears not to take her mother's legacy, the precious botanical herbarium.
moments.key_dialogue: Catherine! Please! That book is my mother's only legacy!

moments.description: Catherine scornfully dismisses the botanical remedies as weeds and chillingly threatens to frame Juliana for witchcraft.
moments.key_dialogue: The magistrate will call it witchcraft.

moments.description: Catherine maliciously vows to burn the book and hang Juliana so that no one will remember her mother's work.
The guards brutally shove Juliana onto the wet stone floor before slamming and locking the heavy iron cell door.
After a breakdown in isolation, Juliana hardens her expression with steely resolve and vows they will never take Alexander from her.
moments.key_dialogue: They took my mother's ledger... They took her locket. But they will not take Alexander from me.
